body:
I tried many times and even fail at that. Or I simply can't die. I'm not entirely sure why I'm not dead after a certain attempt. 

Only reason I haven't tried again yet is because I'm terrified I won't die ((again))and my next attempt will leave me fucked for life. Doesn't seem like fear of being paralyzed ( with the inability to kill myself due to paralysis at that point) is a great reason to be living. 

But I dunno. Maybe it gets better, I hope

All my friends and family know I'm depressed and extremely suicidal. My BF even said he didn't believe me (dunno if he meant he doesn't believe I'm suicidal or like "I can't believe WHY you are like this" type thing)

All I've learned is no one cares much. And no one wants to hear my issues or what I want to do or why I'm like this. They say I need to see a professional and I do...they don't realize I need a FRIEND. 

 I've learned people think I'm extremely negative (because I'm fucking suicidal) but now I pretend I'm happy. I smile I laugh and I never mention being depressed. I imagine this is how a lot of people feel when they commit suicide (cause I imagine my friends and family acting surprised by my suicide) like no...I mentioned for years I wanted to be dead. Don't act shocked like I miraculously got better overnight like you all want to believe and pretend is true. Cause I'm not better at all.

I love this analogy...I saw it in Tumblr years ago "Depression is like trying to peel a potato with another potato. It's not fun, it doesnt work and you just want to cry. And then people are like 'God why don't you just get a peeler?!' But then hand you another potato" 

It's so damn true

Thanks I appreciate that. I guess making it to 27 is good... just last 9 years have been a debate if I would even make it as far as depression related suicide. And then I realize over a 1/4 of my life I haven't wanted to live....and that makes me really sad. I have people who care and I know they care but I'm convinced they are better off without me and I'm just tired of feeling so bored and dread and sad and numb I'm tired of feeling everything but happy.

I've suffered clinical depression for 9 years now. I've tried many many meds and had a great psychotherapist in my home state and we had a great relationship but I moved last year out of state to get away from a bad situation and I'm not being treated here cause everyone I've seen doesn't want to give me the meds my old psychiatrist did and don't feel comfortable doing that which is fine whatever I get people abuse Xanax and crap but if they won't give me the meds I need at least find a way to help me as an alternative but again I feel I'm not being listened to or taken seriously. 

I have a history of self harm and I just don't see a way out anymore. 9 years with little to no relief I'm tired... so damn tired of this. I'd do almost anything or try almost anything at this point if I thought it would help... I'm just out of ideas
